scope: Prospective current root contract. Historical and mixed-role fixture bytes remain data, never a current authorization shim. Local tests do not establish signatures or host enforcement.

verificationOnlyV2Closure.scope: Unchanged current v2 closure copied into fresh controlled repositories so the actual retained v2 checker executes; not a v3 amendment owner or historical reconstruction

limits: Union of the seven explicitly selected existing policy inventories plus reviewed current helpers, tests and source-binding roles; not a claim to govern every protocol subsystem.

Classification describes the role and amendment write boundary. Custody separately distinguishes prospective byte protection, base policy, semantic-only source and required absence. All preserved records retain their baseline bytes during this amendment; semantic-only sources may change in future transitions if their bound semantics remain valid.

New byte ownership is explicit in newlyByteProtectedPaths: selected current governance tests/helpers, new current RED evidence, and the preserved successor fixture closure. This does not include every runtime dependency imported by a broad subsystem test. Stage custody preserves all non-editable source inputs separately.
These are baseline inspection hashes, not future GREEN pins. No source, policy or workflow was modified or executed.

runner:
set -euo pipefail
: "${BASE_SHA:?explicit transition base is required}"
: "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE:?repository root is required}"
: "${RUNNER_TEMP:?runner temporary directory is required}"
BASE_COMMIT="$(git rev-parse --verify --end-of-options "${BASE_SHA}^{commit}")"
MERGE_BASE="$(git merge-base --all "$BASE_COMMIT" HEAD)"
case "$MERGE_BASE" in
  ''|*[!0-9a-f]*) echo "Exactly one merge-base is required." >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
if [ "${#MERGE_BASE}" -ne 40 ]; then
  echo "A complete SHA-1 merge-base is required for this repository." >&2
  exit 1
fi
CHECK_DIRECTORY="$(mktemp -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/protocol-v3-current.XXXXXX")"
git show "$MERGE_BASE:packages/protocol-v2/scripts/check-protocol-freeze.mjs" > "$CHECK_DIRECTORY/check-protocol-v2-freeze.mjs"
git show "$MERGE_BASE:packages/protocol-v3/scripts/check-protocol-v3-freeze.mjs" > "$CHECK_DIRECTORY/check-protocol-v3-freeze.mjs"

  node "$CHECK_DIRECTORY/check-protocol-v2-freeze.mjs" "$MERGE_BASE"
PROTOCOL_V3_FREEZE_REPOSITORY_ROOT="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" \
  node "$CHECK_DIRECTORY/check-protocol-v3-freeze.mjs" "$MERGE_BASE"

oracle.construction: Frozen grammar tags, minimal varuint, BigInt zigzag, complete encoded-key sorting, explicit DRP-NUL/U32BE/U64BE framing and Node SHA-256; no project codec or hash helper was invoked
